detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Enough of wasting precious time? Want to get to the fun part quickly? RAIDBORN cures your open-world fatigue, cuts out the filler, and delivers a pure dungeon crawling experience.

RAIDBORN is a first-person fantasy action RPG built for replayability. Explore an endless stream of dungeons and quests, dive into satisfying combat, and loot legendary treasures. Craft powerful gear, upgrade your outpost, and tailor your experience from relaxed adventure to hardcore roguelike.









Build your outpost and hire a crew to support your adventures. Choose from a wide range of skills and become a swordmaster, barbarian, rogue, craftsman, or anything in between.

  • Build and man your own outpost
  • Open skill system for maximum build freedom
  • Deep crafting and enchanting system
  • Hundreds of unique items





Jump into a fast and satisfying combat flow and experiment with a large variety of weapons and abilities. Choose from a diverse arsenal of melee and ranged weapons to crush the hordes of evil.

  • Satisfying combo system
  • Quality ragdolls for great weapon feedback
  • Kick enemies into traps and abysses
  • Enemies with distinct abilities and fighting styles





Explore a detailed fantasy world where each playthrough offers a completely new experience. Uncover hidden treasures, meet unusual characters, and discover handcrafted encounters.

  • Highly detailed levels that tell a story
  • Quirky quests and unusual characters
  • Handcrafted encounters
  • Riddles and hidden treasures
